gain.title: Gain
gain.description: Gain moves from 0 dB to −60 dB about three seconds in, while a 220 Hz tone that jumps between quiet and loud plays through the Gain. More negative values make it quieter.

gain.title: Every setting
gain.description: A silent tour of the Gain Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Volume moves from 100% to 0% about three seconds in, while a 220 Hz tone that jumps between quiet and loud plays through the Volume. 0% silences this output.

volume.title: Every setting
volume.description: A silent tour of the Volume Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

bassTreble.title: Bass
bassTreble.description: Bass moves from 0 dB to −12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Bass & Treble. Cuts low frequencies.

bassTreble.title: Treble
bassTreble.description: Treble moves from 0 dB to −12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Bass & Treble. Reduces brightness.

bassTreble.title: Bass frequency
bassTreble.description: Bass frequency moves from 500 Hz to 160 Hz about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Bass & Treble. Keeps the adjustment lower in the spectrum.

bassTreble.title: Treble frequency
bassTreble.description: Treble frequency moves from 1,500 Hz to 5,000 Hz about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Bass & Treble. Keeps the adjustment in higher frequencies.

bassTreble.title: Every setting
bassTreble.description: A silent tour of the Bass & Treble Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

graphicEq.title: 31.5 Hz
graphicEq.description: 31.5 Hz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Boost only if your source has clean sub-bass and your speakers can reproduce it.

graphicEq.title: 63 Hz
graphicEq.description: 63 Hz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Add a small amount when a clean source sounds too thin at the bottom.

graphicEq.title: 125 Hz
graphicEq.description: 125 Hz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Add a little if a close-miked voice or instrument feels too lean.

graphicEq.title: 250 Hz
graphicEq.description: 250 Hz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Boost gently when a source lacks body and sounds small.

graphicEq.title: 500 Hz
graphicEq.description: 500 Hz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Boost modestly if it has lost body after other cuts.

graphicEq.title: 1 kHz
graphicEq.description: 1 kHz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Add a little if the midrange feels distant after level matching.

graphicEq.title: 2 kHz
graphicEq.description: 2 kHz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Boost gently when a voice is clear but its articulation is buried.

graphicEq.title: 4 kHz
graphicEq.description: 4 kHz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Add a little when speech lacks presence against background sound.

graphicEq.title: 8 kHz
graphicEq.description: 8 kHz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. Boost subtly if a clean source sounds dull and needs a little sparkle.

graphicEq.title: 16 kHz
graphicEq.description: 16 kHz moves from 0 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Graphic EQ. A tiny boost can add air to a clean, full-band source.

graphicEq.title: Every setting
graphicEq.description: A silent tour of the Graphic EQ Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

parametricEq.title: Band enabled · band 1
parametricEq.description: Band enabled · band 1 is turned off about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Advanced EQ. Off removes its processing contribution.

parametricEq.title: Filter type · band 1
parametricEq.description: Filter type · band 1 switches from Peaking to Low pass about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Advanced EQ. Shape of the selected filter.

parametricEq.title: Frequency · band 1
parametricEq.description: Frequency · band 1 moves from 1,000 Hz to 20 Hz about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Advanced EQ. Moves it toward lower-pitched content.

parametricEq.title: Q · band 1
parametricEq.description: Q · band 1 moves from 1 to 8 about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Advanced EQ. Narrows bell/notch/band-pass filters; may increase resonance in pass filters.

parametricEq.title: Gain · band 1
parametricEq.description: Gain · band 1 moves from 9 dB to −12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the Advanced EQ. Cuts their affected region.

parametricEq.title: Other bands
parametricEq.description: Bands 2–16 work the same way as band 1, so only band 1 is recorded field by field. About three seconds in, a second band is added by double-clicking the graph where it should sit (the Add point button adds one at 1,000 Hz instead), then set to a 9 dB cut at 5,000 Hz. Band 1 keeps its 9 dB boost at 1,000 Hz, so you hear both bands at once while steady pink noise plays through the Advanced EQ. The panel calls each band a point: pick any of them from Select point to change its filter, frequency, gain and Q.

parametricEq.title: Every setting
parametricEq.description: A silent tour of the Advanced EQ Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

compressor.title: Threshold
compressor.description: Threshold moves from −18 dBFS to −60 dBFS about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Compressor. Lower values compress more of the signal.

compressor.title: Ratio
compressor.description: Ratio moves from 3:1 to 8:1 about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Compressor. Applies stronger level reduction.

compressor.title: Attack
compressor.description: Attack moves from 10 ms to 100 ms about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Compressor. Makes engagement slower.

compressor.title: Release
compressor.description: Release moves from 150 ms to 600 ms about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Compressor. Makes recovery slower.

compressor.title: Knee
compressor.description: Knee moves from 6 dB to 18 dB about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Compressor. Makes compression begin more gradually around the boundary.

compressor.title: Makeup gain
compressor.description: Makeup gain moves from 0 dB to 24 dB about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Compressor. Makes the compressed output louder.

compressor.title: Every setting
compressor.description: A silent tour of the Compressor Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

gate.title: Threshold
gate.description: Threshold moves from −45 dBFS to −80 dBFS about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Gate / Expander. Opens for quieter sound and potentially room noise.

gate.title: Range
gate.description: Range moves from 60 dB to 12 dB about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Gate / Expander. Preserves more background; 0 dB disables attenuation.

gate.title: Attack
gate.description: Attack moves from 5 ms to 100 ms about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Gate / Expander. Makes engagement slower.

gate.title: Hysteresis
gate.description: Hysteresis moves from 3 dB to 9 dB about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Gate / Expander. Keeps it open through larger level dips.

gate.title: Ratio
gate.description: Ratio moves from 4:1 to 1:1 about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Gate / Expander. Approaches unchanged dynamics at 1:1.

gate.title: Hold
gate.description: Hold moves from 50 ms to 600 ms about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Gate / Expander. Bridges longer gaps.

gate.title: Release
gate.description: Release moves from 150 ms to 600 ms about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Gate / Expander. Makes recovery slower.

gate.title: Every setting
gate.description: A silent tour of the Gate / Expander Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

limiter.title: Ceiling
limiter.description: Ceiling moves from −1 dBFS to −12 dBFS about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Limiter. Leaves more headroom.

limiter.title: Look-ahead
limiter.description: Look-ahead moves from 5 ms to 10 ms about three seconds in, while a simple drum loop plays through the Limiter. Adds more look-ahead and delay.

limiter.title: Release
limiter.description: Release moves from 100 ms to 600 ms about three seconds in, while a simple drum loop plays through the Limiter. Makes recovery slower.

limiter.title: Every setting
limiter.description: A silent tour of the Limiter Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: Delay moves from 0 ms to 1,000 ms about three seconds in, while a simple drum loop plays through the Sync (delay). Moves sound later.

delay.title: Every setting
delay.description: A silent tour of the Sync (delay) Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

pitch.title: Semitones
pitch.description: Semitones moves from 0 to −12 about three seconds in, while a tone that steps up from 220 Hz to 1,760 Hz plays through the Pitch. Lowers pitch.

pitch.title: Fine tune
pitch.description: Fine tune moves from 0 cents to 70 cents about three seconds in, while a tone that steps up from 220 Hz to 1,760 Hz plays through the Pitch. Raises pitch slightly.

pitch.title: Every setting
pitch.description: A silent tour of the Pitch Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

dehum.title: Mains frequency
dehum.description: Mains frequency moves from 60 Hz to 45 Hz about three seconds in, while a test voice over 50 Hz mains hum plays through the Dehum. Moves the series lower.

dehum.title: Amount
dehum.description: Amount moves from 50% to 0% about three seconds in, while a test voice over 50 Hz mains hum plays through the Dehum. Approaches exact unity at 0%.

dehum.title: Harmonics
dehum.description: Harmonics moves from 4 to 1 about three seconds in, while a test voice over 50 Hz hum and its overtones plays through the Dehum. Limits treatment to fewer hum components.

dehum.title: Every setting
dehum.description: A silent tour of the Dehum Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

declick.title: Threshold
declick.description: Threshold moves from 50% to 0% about three seconds in, while quiet hiss with sharp clicks plays through the Declick. Detects more subtle clicks.

declick.title: Every setting
declick.description: A silent tour of the Declick Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

denoise.title: Reduction
denoise.description: Reduction moves from 70% to 0% about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Denoise. Retains more original sound.

denoise.title: Noise left in
denoise.description: Noise left in moves from 10% to 60% about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Denoise. Retains more background and may sound more natural.

denoise.title: Learn noise
denoise.description: Learn noise is turned on about three seconds in, while quiet background hiss plays through the Denoise. Start learning only while the unwanted background is present.

denoise.title: Every setting
denoise.description: A silent tour of the Denoise Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

speechDenoise.title: Strength
speechDenoise.description: Strength moves from 70% to 0% about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Speech Denoise. Retains more of the original signal.

speechDenoise.title: Every setting
speechDenoise.description: A silent tour of the Speech Denoise Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

spectralGate.title: Threshold above noise
spectralGate.description: Threshold above noise moves from 3 dB to −20 dB about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Spectral Gate. Lets more frequency regions pass.

spectralGate.title: Reduction
spectralGate.description: Reduction moves from 40 dB to 10 dB about three seconds in, while a buzzy test voice over background hiss plays through the Spectral Gate. Keeps more sound in blocked regions.

spectralGate.title: Learn noise
spectralGate.description: Learn noise is turned on about three seconds in, while quiet background hiss plays through the Spectral Gate. Start learning only while the unwanted background is present.

spectralGate.title: Every setting
spectralGate.description: A silent tour of the Spectral Gate Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

firFilter.title: Wet mix
firFilter.description: Wet mix moves from 100% to 0% about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the FIR Filter. Includes more dry sound.

firFilter.title: Output gain
firFilter.description: Output gain moves from 0 dB to −12 dB about three seconds in, while steady pink noise plays through the FIR Filter. More negative values make it quieter.

firFilter.title: Every setting
firFilter.description: A silent tour of the FIR Filter Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

mute.title: Muted
mute.description: Muted is turned on about three seconds in, while a 220 Hz tone that jumps between quiet and loud plays through the Mute. On sends silence from this tool.

mute.title: Every setting
mute.description: A silent tour of the Mute Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

inputSwitch.title: Active input
inputSwitch.description: Active input switches from A to B about three seconds in, while input A carries a low 110 Hz tone and input B a high 880 Hz tone. Which explicitly wired port is heard.

inputSwitch.title: Switch speed
inputSwitch.description: Switch speed switches from Normal to Slow about three seconds in, while input A carries a low 110 Hz tone and input B a high 880 Hz tone. Length of the equal-power input transition.

inputSwitch.title: Every setting
inputSwitch.description: A silent tour of the Input Switch Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

outputSwitch.title: Active output
outputSwitch.description: Active output switches from A to B about three seconds in, while a low 110 Hz tone plays through the Output Switch. Which output port receives audio. You're listening to output A, so the sound stops when the switch moves to B.

outputSwitch.title: Every setting
outputSwitch.description: A silent tour of the Output Switch Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

duck.title: Trigger level
duck.description: Trigger level moves from −35 dBFS to −80 dBFS about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Duck. Engages for quieter trigger sound, potentially room noise.

duck.title: Amount
duck.description: Amount moves from 6 dB to 0 dB about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Duck. Keeps it closer to normal level; 0 dB makes no reduction.

duck.title: Attack
duck.description: Attack moves from 20 ms to 100 ms about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Duck. Makes engagement slower.

duck.title: Hold
duck.description: Hold moves from 300 ms to 600 ms about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Duck. Bridges longer gaps.

duck.title: Release
duck.description: Release moves from 500 ms to 600 ms about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Duck. Makes recovery slower.

duck.title: Every setting
duck.description: A silent tour of the Duck Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

duck.title: Siege round trigger
duck.description: A silent look at the Siege round trigger: choose which parts of a Siege match lower the sound. Hearing it work needs live game data from a match in progress, so this clip has no audio.

duck.title: Triggered by another node
duck.description: A silent look at the Triggered by setting: pick another node in the same session, such as your processed voice, whose level lowers this sound. Hearing it work needs that second source playing, so this clip has no audio.

timeShift.title: Rewind buffer
timeShift.description: Rewind buffer moves from 60 s to 10 s about three seconds in, while a simple drum loop plays through the Time Shift. Keeps less history.

timeShift.title: Every setting
timeShift.description: A silent tour of the Time Shift Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

mixer.title: Input volume
mixer.description: Input volume moves from 100% to 0% about three seconds in, while a two-tone chord of 110 Hz and 880 Hz plays through the Mixer. Lowers it; 0% removes its contribution.

mixer.title: Every setting
mixer.description: A silent tour of the Mixer Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

meter.title: Live level
meter.description: A 220 Hz tone that jumps between quiet and loud plays through the Meter. Watch the readings rise and fall with it.

meter.title: Every setting
meter.description: A silent tour of the Meter Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

funVoiceChanger.title: Preset
funVoiceChanger.description: Preset switches from Custom to Robot about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. The starting voice. Choosing one writes all of its settings at once.

funVoiceChanger.title: Noise gate
funVoiceChanger.description: Noise gate moves from −90 dBFS to −20 dBFS about three seconds in, while a short, buzzy test voice plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Ignores more room and keyboard noise.

funVoiceChanger.title: Pitch correction
funVoiceChanger.description: Pitch correction is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. The voice keeps its own pitch.

funVoiceChanger.title: Key
funVoiceChanger.description: Key switches from C to C♯ about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. The key of the correction scale.

funVoiceChanger.title: Scale
funVoiceChanger.description: Scale switches from Major to Chromatic about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Which notes correction may use.

funVoiceChanger.title: Retune speed
funVoiceChanger.description: Retune speed moves from 50 ms to 150 ms about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Slower, more natural correction.

funVoiceChanger.title: Humanize
funVoiceChanger.description: Humanize moves from 0% to 80% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Long notes keep more natural vibrato.

funVoiceChanger.title: Pitch and formant
funVoiceChanger.description: Pitch and formant is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. The voice keeps its pitch and size.

funVoiceChanger.title: Pitch
funVoiceChanger.description: Pitch moves from 7 st to −7 st about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Lower voice; −12 is one octave down.

funVoiceChanger.title: Fine pitch
funVoiceChanger.description: Fine pitch moves from 0 cents to 70 cents about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Slightly higher.

funVoiceChanger.title: Formant
funVoiceChanger.description: Formant moves from 3 st to −4 st about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Bigger, darker voice.

funVoiceChanger.title: Ring modulator
funVoiceChanger.description: Ring modulator is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. No ring modulation.

funVoiceChanger.title: Ring frequency
funVoiceChanger.description: Ring frequency moves from 70 Hz to 160 Hz about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Bell-like, alien sound.

funVoiceChanger.title: Ring depth
funVoiceChanger.description: Ring depth moves from 70% to 20% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. More of the normal voice.

funVoiceChanger.title: Bit crusher
funVoiceChanger.description: Bit crusher is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Clean sound.

funVoiceChanger.title: Bits
funVoiceChanger.description: Bits moves from 6 to 12 about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Cleaner; 16 is clean.

funVoiceChanger.title: Downsample
funVoiceChanger.description: Downsample moves from 4 to 12 about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Lo-fi, muffled and aliased.

funVoiceChanger.title: Saturation
funVoiceChanger.description: Saturation is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. No distortion.

funVoiceChanger.title: Drive
funVoiceChanger.description: Drive moves from 45% to 80% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. More distortion.

funVoiceChanger.title: Whisper
funVoiceChanger.description: Whisper moves from 0% to 85% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. More breathy whisper.

funVoiceChanger.title: Tone
funVoiceChanger.description: Tone is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Full range.

funVoiceChanger.title: Low cut
funVoiceChanger.description: Low cut moves from 20 Hz to 350 Hz about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Thinner sound.

funVoiceChanger.title: High cut
funVoiceChanger.description: High cut moves from 20,000 Hz to 3,000 Hz about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Duller, more muffled sound.

funVoiceChanger.title: Peak frequency
funVoiceChanger.description: Peak frequency moves from 1,000 Hz to 2,500 Hz about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Brighter, thinner character.

funVoiceChanger.title: Peak
funVoiceChanger.description: Peak moves from 9 dB to −12 dB about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Cuts that frequency.

funVoiceChanger.title: Modulation
funVoiceChanger.description: Modulation is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. No modulation.

funVoiceChanger.title: Modulation type
funVoiceChanger.description: Modulation type switches from Chorus to Flanger about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Chorus doubles the voice; flanger sweeps it.

funVoiceChanger.title: Rate
funVoiceChanger.description: Rate moves from 0.5 Hz to 5 Hz about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Faster wobble.

funVoiceChanger.title: Depth
funVoiceChanger.description: Depth moves from 60% to 15% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Subtler effect.

funVoiceChanger.title: Feedback
funVoiceChanger.description: Feedback moves from 0% to 70% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Ringing, metallic sweeps.

funVoiceChanger.title: Space
funVoiceChanger.description: Space is turned off about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Dry voice.

funVoiceChanger.title: Room size
funVoiceChanger.description: Room size moves from 50% to 85% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Bigger, more distant space.

funVoiceChanger.title: Echo length
funVoiceChanger.description: Echo length moves from 1,000 ms to 3,000 ms about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Longer echo.

funVoiceChanger.title: Echo level
funVoiceChanger.description: Echo level moves from 40% to 75% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. More echo.

funVoiceChanger.title: Mix
funVoiceChanger.description: Mix moves from 100% to 30% about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. More of your normal voice; 0 % is unchanged.

funVoiceChanger.title: Output
funVoiceChanger.description: Output moves from 0 dB to −12 dB about three seconds in, while a test voice that glides up and down in pitch plays through the Fun Voice Changer. Quieter.

funVoiceChanger.title: Every setting
funVoiceChanger.description: A silent tour of the Fun Voice Changer Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

physicalInput.title: Every setting
physicalInput.description: A silent tour of the Physical Input Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

physicalOutput.title: Every setting
physicalOutput.description: A silent tour of the Physical Output Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

applicationCapture.title: Every setting
applicationCapture.description: A silent tour of the Application Capture Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

endpointLoopback.title: Every setting
endpointLoopback.description: A silent tour of the Endpoint Loopback Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

virtualRenderSource.title: Every setting
virtualRenderSource.description: A silent tour of the Virtual Render Source Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

virtualCaptureSink.title: Every setting
virtualCaptureSink.description: A silent tour of the Virtual Capture Sink Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

testSignal.title: Tone frequency
testSignal.description: Tone frequency moves from 440 Hz to 880 Hz about three seconds in, while the Test Signal plays its test tone. Makes the sine wave oscillate faster and sound higher.

testSignal.title: Level
testSignal.description: Level moves from −18 dBFS to −30 dBFS about three seconds in, while the Test Signal plays its test tone. Reduces tone amplitude.

testSignal.title: Duration
testSignal.description: Duration moves from 8,000 ms to 2,000 ms about three seconds in, while the Test Signal plays its test tone. Produces a shorter burst.

testSignal.title: Every setting
testSignal.description: A silent tour of the Test Signal Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

audioFile.title: Loop
audioFile.description: Loop is turned on about three seconds in, while the Audio File plays a prepared tone file. Repeat the imported audio when it reaches the end. The clip is shorter than the file, so you won't hear it start over.

audioFile.title: Every setting
audioFile.description: A silent tour of the Audio File Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

soundboard.title: Caption · button 1
soundboard.description: Caption · button 1 is set to “Bright tone” about three seconds in. The change has no sound of its own, so this clip is silent. The name shown on the button. When empty, the sound's file name is used.

soundboard.title: Level · button 1
soundboard.description: Level · button 1 moves from 0 dB to −24 dB about three seconds in, while the Soundboard plays a prepared tone file. The sound plays quieter.

soundboard.title: When pressed · button 1
soundboard.description: When pressed · button 1 is set to Toggle about three seconds in. The change has no sound of its own, so this clip is silent. Play once (a second press restarts it), Loop, Toggle on/off, or Play while held.

soundboard.title: Every setting
soundboard.description: A silent tour of the Soundboard Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

recorder.title: Every setting
recorder.description: A silent tour of the Recorder Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

networkSend.title: Every setting
networkSend.description: A silent tour of the Network Send Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

networkReceive.title: Every setting
networkReceive.description: A silent tour of the Network Receive Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

plugin.title: Every setting
plugin.description: A silent tour of the VST Plugin Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.

group.title: Every setting
group.description: A silent tour of the Visual Group Properties panel. It scrolls through every setting, then returns to the top.
